findings.title: Comparator MACE pool incorrectly described as containing 16 trials

claim.quote: pooled MACE OR 0.79 (95% CI 0.71-0.89) over 16 RCTs

evidence.quote: Treatment with GLP-1 RAs or GIP/GLP-1 RAs was associated with significant reduction of MACE (7 RCTs; OR: 0.79; 95% CI: 0.71–0.89;

findings.why_wrong: Sixteen is the comparator review's total trial count. Its MACE analysis contains seven trials.
findings.served_effect: The served protocol text overstates the number of trials supporting the comparator MACE estimate.
findings.proposed_fixture: Use the held comparator clause containing 'MACE (7 RCTs; OR: 0.79' and the current protocol/page as input. Assert that the rendered MACE estimate is attributed to seven RCTs, while 16 is retained only as the review-wide count.

findings.title: SELECT subgroup report excluded as an off-topic population

evidence.quote: In SELECT, people with overweight or obesity and atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease without diabetes were randomized to weekly semaglutide 2.4 mg or placebo.

OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the cardiovascular effects of semaglutide by baseline glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c) and change in HbA1c in a prespecified analysis of Semaglutide Effects on Cardiovascular Outcomes in People With Overweight or Obesity (SELECT).

findings.why_wrong: The held abstract explicitly describes the registered population. Failure to match the configured title phrases does not establish a population mismatch. This is a secondary analysis of SELECT and should be handled through report/family linkage.
findings.served_effect: The screening table gives a false population exclusion and separates relevant supplementary evidence from the included trial. This does not establish an additional independent trial for pooling.
findings.proposed_fixture: Screen the held PMID 38907684 record with the topic configuration. Assert that it does not receive X2; identify it as a SELECT secondary report and retain one independent SELECT contribution.

findings.title: Comparator population falsely marked as matching

evidence.quote: RCTs on GLP-1 RAs or GIP/GLP-1 RAs—with the exception of SELECT—included overweight or obese adults without cardiovascular comorbidities

adults with overweight or obesity and established cardiovascular disease but
  without diabetes.

findings.why_wrong: Established cardiovascular disease is required by this topic. The comparator explicitly includes a broader population, largely without cardiovascular comorbidities. The current scope function reproduces population_match=true from lexical overlap.
findings.served_effect: The comparator remains rejected overall, but its structured scope assessment omits a material population mismatch.
findings.proposed_fixture: Use the topic's established-CVD requirement and the held comparator population statement as inputs to scope assessment. Assert population_match=false and scope_valid=false, with both population and intervention differences recorded.

findings.title: SELECT age eligibility marked not stated despite explicit held text

evidence.quote: we enrolled patients 45 years of age or older who had preexisting cardiovascular disease

findings.why_wrong: The source states an adult eligibility threshold explicitly. The age parser fails to recognize 'patients 45 years of age or older'; a read-only call reproduced not_stated.
findings.served_effect: Both pooled SELECT outcome rows lose source-supported age information in their compatibility metadata.
findings.proposed_fixture: Pass the held PMID 37952131 record to harness.compat_check._derive_population_age({}, record). Assert value='adult' and a supporting span containing '45 years of age or older'. The current function returns not_stated.
